law_name: Qualified Law 29/2021 of 28 October on the Protection of Personal Data
scope: Data subjects whose data is processed in Andorra or by non-domiciled controllers using means there
applies_to: All public and private controllers and processors; foreign controllers must designate a representative
key_requirements: GDPR-aligned legal bases and data-subject rights; accountability; independent supervisory agency (art. 46)
enforcement_authority: Andorran Data Protection Agency (Agencia Andorrana de Proteccio de Dades - APDA)
penalties_range: Administrative fines reportedly up to EUR 100,000 depending on severity (single compliance-site claim; statute not seen) (unconfirmed)
deceased_data: Deceased persons listed among excluded data categories by one source, with unspecified exceptions (unconfirmed)
notes: 74 articles, 7 chapters, published in BOPA 2021-11-17, replaced Law 15/2003; implementing Decree 391/2022. EU adequacy decision dated 2010-10-19. Party to Convention 108+ (ratified 2022-10-18).
